[P1] 没有靴子的猫
méi yǒu xuē zi de māo

[P2] 也许，你听过《穿靴子的猫》这个故事。那只穿靴子的猫由于帮助他的主人，让他的主人交上了好运，而受到人们的称赞。

从此，有不少猫都模仿这只穿靴子的猫，穿上了各种颜色的靴子。

他们还互相比较，看谁脚上的靴子更漂亮、更时尚。

[P1] The Cat Without Boots
méi yǒu xuē zi de māo

[P2] Maybe you've heard the story of 'Puss in Boots.' That cat, by helping his master, brought his master good luck and earned praise from everyone.

Since then, many cats have imitated this boot-wearing cat, putting on boots of various colors.

They even compare with each other, seeing whose boots are prettier and more fashionable.

[P3] yǒu yī zhī táo sè de xiǎo māo, jiào tián yě
There is a amber-colored little cat, called "Field Cat".
māo.
Cat.

Why does he have such a strange name?

Originally, Field Cat is an orphan cat who lost his parents at a young age.

forests and fields, so people call him "Field Cat".

[P4] The field cat sometimes goes to the city to stroll.
However, every time the field cat goes to the city, it gets bullied.
By those cats in the city who are well-dressed and wear boots.
They surround the field cat and say, "Look, a barefoot cat, a cat who doesn't even have a single pair of little boots!"
These cats even kick him with their boot-clad feet,
and that makes the field cat very angry.
Of course, not all cats are like that. In the city,
there are also some little cats who can't afford boots and are barefoot.
These little cats all love to be friends with the field cat.
These barefoot cats often play together.

However, every time the field cat goes to the city, it gets bullied
by those stylish, boot-wearing cats in the city.
They surround the field cat and say, "Hey, a

[P6] Those cats wearing boots took off their long boots, short boots, red boots, blue boots, and yellow boots, following behind the field cat, wanting to exchange their noble boots for the field cat's grass shoes.
The field cat didn't even look at these boots and said:
"I don't care for these heavy boots that make my feet feel stuffy and creak when I walk. I love my beautiful grass shoes!"
Please exchange shoes with me!
Walking into many beautiful wildflowers.
The field cat went into the city wearing his grass shoes.
The field cat's grass shoes amazed the cats in the city who wore boots. How beautiful these little grass shoes are! They are cool and beautiful to wear, and they even have a pleasant fragrance.

[P7] The barefoot kittens in the city surrounded Field Cat, saying, “Look at you, you have such unique and lovely shoes!
“Come on,” Field Cat said to his barefoot friends, “Please come with me to the fields, I’ll give each of you a pair of beautiful shoes.
This group of cats without boots all followed Field Cat to the fields.
Field Cat wove a pair of little grass shoes for each barefoot cat, and said, “Happiness must be created by ourselves!”

[P8] These barefoot kittens put on the shoes called
"Field Cat Shoes" and went into the city.
From then on—
"Field Cat Shoes" became the most popular shoes in the city.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《没有靴子的猫》及其拼音注音。
[P2] 本页介绍了经典故事《穿靴子的猫》的背景，并说明许多猫开始模仿它，穿上各种颜色的靴子，还互相比较谁的靴子更漂亮、更时尚。
[P3] 本页介绍了主角‘田野猫’的来历：它是一只失去父母的孤儿猫，独自在森林和田野中勇敢生活，因此得名‘田野猫’。它喜欢在自然中奔跑、钓鱼、爬树和听风中树叶的歌声。
[P4] 本页描述了田野猫进城时被穿靴子的猫欺负，感到生气，但也有光脚猫与它做朋友。后来，田野猫在草地上想到用野草为自己做鞋子，并开始动手编织草鞋。
[P5] 田野猫进城时被穿靴子的猫欺负，感到生气，但也有光脚猫与它做朋友。后来，田野猫在草地上想到用野草为自己做鞋子，并开始动手编织草鞋。
[P6] 田野猫穿着自己编织的草鞋进城，引来了穿靴子的猫们的围观和交换请求，但田野猫拒绝了，他喜爱自己的草鞋。画面中，田野猫在花丛中行走，而其他猫则试图用各种靴子与他交换草鞋。
[P7] 田野猫为城里的光脚小猫们编织草鞋，并邀请他们到田野里去，鼓励大家靠自己创造快乐。
[P8] 一群光脚小猫穿上田野猫制作的草鞋进城，从此这种鞋在城里流行起来。
